# BrushShininess <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Brushes](Blitz3D-Brushes)

</div>


```blitzbasic
BrushShininess:Void brush:Int32, shininess:Float32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `brush` | In | Int32 | required | The brush. |
| `shininess` | In | Float32 | required | Shininess, 0 to 1. The default is 0. |

## Description

Sets the strength of the specular highlight on painted surfaces. 0 gives matt surfaces and 1 a very shiny, billiard-ball look when a light shines on them.
